raw.details:
About the Challenge

  • Welcome to the AI Vision Challenge 2026, an online creative challenge organized by Skillinf for students, creators, developers, designers, and AI enthusiasts.
  • Your challenge is simple: Use AI prompting skills to create an outstanding AI-generated image based on the given challenge theme.
  • Participants will be evaluated on their creativity, prompt quality, originality, visual quality, relevance to the theme, and effective use of AI image-generation tools.

Challenge Objective

  • Create a unique AI-generated image that demonstrates how effectively you can turn an idea into a compelling visual using AI.
  • Participants can use AI image-generation platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Leonardo AI, or other suitable AI tools.

What You Need to Do

  1. Register for the AI Vision Challenge.
  2. Read the challenge theme/instructions provided by the organizers.
  3. Create your image using an AI image-generation tool.
  4. Develop an effective prompt to generate your image.
  5. Submit your final AI-generated image along with the prompt used.
  6. Make sure your submission is original and follows the challenge rules.

Submission Requirements

Participants must submit:

  • Final AI-generated image
  • The prompt used to generate the image
  • AI tool/platform used
  • A short description of the concept
  • Participant name and required registration details

Evaluation Criteria

Submissions will be evaluated based on:

  • Creativity & Originality
  • Prompt Quality
  • Visual Quality
  • Concept & Storytelling
  • Relevance to the Challenge Theme
  • Effective Use of AI
  • Overall Presentation

Who Can Participate?

The challenge is open to:

  • College Students
  • School Students
  • Freshers
  • Working Professionals
  • AI Enthusiasts
  • Designers & Creators
  • Developers
  • Anyone interested in Generative AI

No advanced technical knowledge is required.

Recommended Skills

  • Generative AI
  • AI Image Generation
  • Prompt Engineering
  • Creative Thinking
  • Visual Design
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Digital Creativity

Rules

  1. The submitted image must be generated using an AI image-generation tool.
  2. Participants must submit the prompt used to generate the image.
  3. The submission should be created specifically for this challenge.
  4. Do not submit copyrighted images, downloaded artwork, or another person's work.
  5. Participants must not intentionally generate harmful, illegal, hateful, or inappropriate content.
  6. Minor post-processing is allowed, but the primary visual should be AI-generated.
  7. Each participant should submit their own work.
  8. The organizers reserve the right to disqualify submissions that violate the rules.
  9. The judges' decision regarding the selected submissions will be final.

Why Participate?

  • Explore the power of Generative AI
  • Improve your prompt engineering skills
  • Showcase your creativity
  • Build your AI portfolio
  • Gain experience with modern AI tools
  • Get an opportunity to have your work recognized by the Skillinf community

Challenge Theme

The specific image-generation theme and submission instructions will be shared with registered participants.

Think creatively. Write better prompts. Create something remarkable.

Create. Prompt. Generate. Inspire.

Join the AI Vision Challenge 2026 and show us what you can create with Generative AI!
